# ernestocisneros.art - LLM Context

> Ernesto Cisneros Cino: Cuban composer, pianist, digital artist, mathematician, and writer based in Miami.
> This site is his complete artistic and intellectual archive, available in 7 languages.

## Site Structure
- / - Homepage
- /music - Albums: Mare Incognitum, Glacial Paths, Atlas of Fragmented Light, Sandbank, Trash, Velvet Alloy, Nocturne of Glass Currents, Other Musical Works
- /books - Published books (6 titles, detailed below)
- /ideas - Essays: cosmology, philosophy, technology, culture, Cuba series (9 essays + prologue)
- /nft - Digital art on Ethereum, Tezos, Bitcoin
- /biography - Full biography (Wikipedia, IMDb, ORCID linked)
- /impulses-art - Music therapy program for refugees and vulnerable communities
- /contact - Contact and collaborations

## Published Books

### Sombras, Datos y Relampagos (Shadows, Data and Lightning)
- Genre: Fiction, Essay, Poetry (hybrid work)
- Series: Power Trilogy, Vol. 1
- Language: Spanish
- Available on: Amazon Kindle
- URL: /books/sombras-datos-relampagos/
- Themes: Power, surveillance, invisible infrastructure, poetic intuition

### La Sospecha Razonable (Reasonable Suspicion)
- Genre: Speculative Fiction, Short Stories (12 stories)
- Series: Power Trilogy, Vol. 2
- Language: Spanish
- Available on: Amazon Kindle
- URL: /books/la-sospecha-razonable/
- Themes: Reality questioning, philosophical speculation, strangeness of the everyday

### No apagues la luz (Don't Turn Off the Light)
- Genre: Psychological Horror, Short Stories (11 stories + prologue)
- Language: Spanish and English (full bilingual web edition)
- Price: $3.99 (PDF)
- Read free online: /es/books/no-apagues-la-luz/contenido.html (ES), /books/dont-turn-off-the-light/contents.html (EN)
- URL: /books/dont-turn-off-the-light/ (EN), /es/books/no-apagues-la-luz/ (ES)
- Themes: Psychological terror, the uncanny in everyday life, no supernatural elements

### Huella (Footprint)
- Genre: Academic Essay, History of Computing
- Language: Spanish
- Open Access: Zenodo (DOI: 10.5281/zenodo.19589185)
- URL: /books/huella/
- Themes: History of computation from clay tablets to quantum computers

### La Necesidad de Creer (The Need to Believe)
- Genre: Academic Essay, History of Religion, Anthropology
- Language: Spanish and English
- Open Access: Zenodo (DOI: 10.5281/zenodo.19588665)
- URL: /books/la-necesidad-de-creer/
- Themes: 300,000 years of human spirituality, belief systems across cultures

### Manual de bolsillo para sonidistas (Pocket Manual for Sound Engineers)
- Genre: Technical Reference
- Language: Spanish
- Price: $4.00 (PDF)
- Pages: 40
- URL: /books/manual-sonidistas/
- Themes: Gain, phase, EQ, compression, live sound, recording

EN (default), ES (/es/), FR (/fr/), IT (/it/), RU (/ru/), JA (/ja/), KO (/ko/)
All book pages available in all 7 languages with cultural localization (not machine translation).
